readmeExcerpt:
Users and logs provide clues. Sentry provides answers.

# What's Sentry? Sentry is the debugging platform that helps every developer detect, trace, and fix issues. Code breaks, fix it faster.

## Official Sentry SDKs - [JavaScript](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript) - [Electron](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-electron/) - [React-Native](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-react-native) - [Python](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-python) - [Ruby](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-ruby) - [PHP](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-php) - [Laravel](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-laravel) - [Go](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go) - [Rust](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-rust) - [Java/Kotlin](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-java) - [Objective-C/Swift](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-cocoa) - [C\#/F\#](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-dotnet) - [C/C++](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-native) - [Dart/Flutter](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-dart) - [Perl](https://github.com/getsentry/perl-raven) - [Clojure](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-clj/) - [Elixir](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-elixir) - [Unity](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-unity) - [Unreal Engine](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-unreal) - [Godot Engine](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-godot) - [PowerShell](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-powershell) # Resources - [Documentation](https://docs.sentry.io/) - [Discussions](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/discussions) (Bugs, feature requests, general questions) - [Discord](https://discord.gg/PXa5Apfe7K) - [Contributing](https://docs.sentry.io/internal/contributing/) - [Bug Tracker](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/issues) - [Code](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry) - [Transifex](https://explore.transifex.com/getsentry/sentry/) (Translate Sentry\!)

aiSummary.oneLiner: A developer-first debugging platform for error tracking and performance monitoring.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Sentry is an open-source error tracking and performance monitoring platform designed to help developers identify and fix production issues. It captures runtime exceptions, unhandled errors, and performance bottlenecks across the entire application stack. The platform provides detailed stack traces, environment context, and breadcrumbs to diagnose the exact sequence of events leading to a crash. It correlates distributed traces across microservices to uncover latency issues. By aggregating and grouping similar errors, it reduces noise and helps prioritize critical bug fixes.
keyFeatures: Real-time error tracking: Captures exceptions and crashes immediately as they occur in production environments.
Distributed tracing: Follows request paths across distinct microservices to identify performance bottlenecks.
Contextual breadcrumbs: Records user actions, network requests, and system events leading up to an error.
Intelligent issue grouping: Aggregates similar events automatically to prevent alert fatigue and streamline triage.
Release tracking: Correlates errors with specific application versions to pinpoint when regressions were introduced.

useCases.title: Monitor production stability
useCases.description: Track unhandled exceptions in real-time to proactively fix application crashes.

useCases.title: Optimize application performance
useCases.description: Analyze distributed traces and latency metrics to identify slow database queries or API calls.

useCases.title: Accelerate debugging workflows
useCases.description: Utilize detailed stack traces and environmental context to reproduce issues quickly.

useCases.title: Manage release health
useCases.description: Monitor error rates immediately following a deployment to decide whether to rollback.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Software engineering teams aiming to maintain high availability and quickly resolve production bugs. Site reliability engineers needing comprehensive visibility into application performance.
